answer: Tie every agent key to a hardware security chip. The chip maker is the forge: each key is generated inside a TPM whose endorsement certificate chains back to it, and each chip may hold at most two earning keys. Every epoch the key signs a quote over the beacon nonce, so the chip must be online and live. A farm of 500 fakes needs 250 real chips at about $30 each plus a host apiece. Silicon is basalt next to cheap software keys, and if one chip's keys keep showing up in a vine of colluding graders, its certificate is revoked and both keys stop earning.
